title: remote-control STT streaming frames (protocol v1)
description: Text frames on WS /ws/stt?language=<code>. Audio travels as binary frames of PCM16LE, 16 kHz, mono (100-200 ms per frame recommended), which this schema does not cover. Limits: 120 s of audio per utterance, 4 MiB total.

SttStop.description: Client -> gateway: finish and transcribe everything received so far.

SttPartial.description: Gateway -> client, about every 2 s while audio is arriving.

SttFinal.description: Gateway -> client after stt.stop; the gateway then closes the socket.

SttError.description: Gateway -> client on failure; the gateway then closes the socket.
